The '''Lunnes Wastes''' were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sondarr]]. [[Sondarr Base]], the headquarters for the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization [[Star's Nova]], were located in the Lunnes Wastes.
